meta.name: counterexample-generator
meta.description: Generate concrete counterexamples when formal verification, assertions, or specifications fail. Use this skill when debugging failed proofs, understanding why verification fails, creating minimal reproducing examples, analyzing assertion violations, investigating invariant breaks, or diagnosing specification mismatches. Produces concrete input values, execution traces, and state information that demonstrate the failure.

copy.tagline: 生成反例帮你定位验证失败原因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用形式化方法或断言验证代码，却搞不清为什么失败。
